items.title: BNY and Microsoft complete first AI agent-negotiated Treasury trade
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of New York (BNY) and Microsoft Corp (MSFT) had AI agents negotiate a US Treasury trade. They bill it as the first of its kind. Electronic trading and machine-to-machine messaging are old news. What is new is software that deliberates and finds middle ground on price, a role that used to belong to human brokers.
